question: A systems engineer is troubleshooting the connectivity of a test environment that includes a virtual security appliance deployed inline. In addition to using the virtual security appliance, the development team wants to use security groups and network ACLs to accomplish various security requirements in the environment. What configuration is necessary to allow the virtual security appliance to route the traffic?

options.A: Disable network ACLs.
options.B: Configure the security appliance's elastic network interface for promiscuous mode.
options.C: Disable the Network Source/Destination check on the security appliance's elastic network interface.
options.D: Place the security appliance in the public subnet with the internet gateway.

explanations.A: Disable network ACLs. 禁 ⽤ ⽹ 络 ACL 。 错误。 ⽹ 络 ACL 是 ⽤ 于控制 ⼦ ⽹ 级别的 ⼊ 站和出站流量的 ⼯ 具，禁 ⽤ 它不会解决虚拟 安全设备的路由问题。 ⽹ 络 ACL 的存在与否不会影响虚拟安全设备的流量处理能 ⼒ 。
explanations.B: 将安全设备的弹性 ⽹ 络接 ⼝ 配置为混杂模式。 错误。 AWS 的弹性 ⽹ 络接 ⼝ (ENI) 不 ⽀ 持混杂模式。混杂模式通常 ⽤ 于捕获 ⽹ 络流量， 但与路由流量 ⽆ 关。 此选项在 AWS 环境中不可 ⾏ 。
explanations.C: 在安全设备的弹性 ⽹ 络接 ⼝ 上禁 ⽤ ⽹ 络源 / ⽬ 标检查。 正确。默认情况下， AWS 会启 ⽤ “ 源 / ⽬ 标检查 ” ，以确保流量的源和 ⽬ 标地址与实例的 ⽹ 络接 ⼝ 匹配。 对于虚拟安全设备 ( 如防 ⽕ 墙或路由器 ) ，需要禁 ⽤ 此检查，以允许设备处理和转发流 量， ⽽ 不是仅仅接收或发送与 ⾃ ⾝ 相关的流量。
explanations.D: 将安全设备放置在带有互联 ⽹ ⽹ 关的公共 ⼦ ⽹ 中。 错误。将安全设备放置在公共 ⼦ ⽹ 中并不会解决路由问题。此选项与流量的源 / ⽬ 标检 查 ⽆ 关。 虽然公共 ⼦ ⽹ 可以提供互联 ⽹ 访问，但这不是解决虚拟安全设备路由问题的正确 ⽅ 法。

options.B: "Principal": { "AWS": [ "arn:aws:iam::1234567890:root" ] }

explanations.A: Correct. This option correctly adds the Principal field with the ARNs of the three specific users. This ensures only User1, User2, and User3 can access the S3 resources, following the principle of least privilege.
explanations.B: Incorrect. This option sets the Principal to the root account, which grants access to all users in the entire AWS account, violating the principle of least privilege.
explanations.C: Incorrect. This option sets the Principal to "*", meaning it allows everyone access, completely violating the principle of least privilege.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Although the AuthorizedPeople group contains these three users, S3 bucket policies do not support IAM group ARNs as Principal. IAM groups cannot be used as a Principal.

question: A security engineer recently rotated all IAM access keys in an AWS account. The security engineer then configured AWS Config and enabled the following AWS Config managed rules: mfa-enabled-for-iam-console-access, iam-user- mfa-enabled, access-keys- rotated, and iam-user-unused-credentials-check. question: A company has AWS accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations. The organization includes a dedicated security account. All AWS account activity across all member accounts must be logged and reported to the dedicated security account. The company must retain all the activity logs in a secure storage location within the dedicated security account for 2 years. No changes or deletions of the logs are allowed. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? Choose two.)

options.A: In the dedicated security account, create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure S3 Object Lock in compliance mode and a retention period of 2 years on the S3 bucket. Set the bucket policy to allow the organization's management account to write to the S3 bucket.
options.B: In the dedicated security account, create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure S3 Object Lock in compliance mode and a retention period of 2 years on the S3 bucket. Set the bucket policy to allow the organization's member accounts to write to the S3 bucket.
options.C: In the dedicated security account, create an Amazon S3 bucket that has an S3 Lifecycle configuration that expires objects after 2 years. Set the bucket policy to allow the organization's member accounts to write to the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS CloudTrail trail for the organization. Configure logs to be delivered to the logging Amazon S3 bucket in the dedicated security account.
options.E: Turn on AWS CloudTrail in each account. Configure logs to be delivered to an Amazon S3 bucket that is created in the organization's management account. Forward the logs to the S3 bucket in the dedicated security account by using AWS Lambda and Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose.

explanations.A: 在专 ⻔ 的安全账户中，创建 ⼀ 个 Amazon S3 存储桶。在 S3 存储桶上配置 S3 Object Lock 的合规模式，并设置 2 年的保留期。将存储桶策略设置为允许组织的管理账户写 ⼊ S3 存储桶。 正确 :S3 Object Lock 的合规模式确保 ⽇ 志不可篡改且 ⽆ 法删除，符合 2 年的保留要 求。 正确 : 允许组织的 管理账户写 ⼊ ⽇ 志到安全账户的 S3 存储桶，满 ⾜ 集中化存储需求。
explanations.B: 在专 ⻔ 的安全账户中，创建 ⼀ 个 Amazon S3 存储桶。在 S3 存储桶上配置 S3 Object Lock 的合规模式，并设置 2 年的保留期。将存储桶策略设置为允许组织的成员账户写 ⼊ S3 存储桶。 错误 : 直接允许成员账户写 ⼊ ⽇ 志到安全账户的 S3 存储桶可能会增加管理复杂性和安全 ⻛ 险。
explanations.C: 在专 ⻔ 的安全账户中，创建 ⼀ 个具有 S3 ⽣ 命周期配置的 Amazon S3 存储桶，该 配置将在 2 年后过期对象。将 存储桶策略设置为允许组织的成员账户写 ⼊ S3 存储桶。 错误 :S3 ⽣ 命周期配置仅 ⽤ 于对象的 ⾃ 动删除，不满 ⾜ ⽇ 志不可篡改的要求。
explanations.D: 为组织创建 ⼀ 个 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪。配置 ⽇ 志将传送到专 ⻔ 安全账户中的 ⽇ 志 Amazon S3 存储桶。 正确 : 组织级别的 CloudTrail 可以集中记录所有成员账户的活动 ⽇ 志，减少操作开销。 正确 : 将 ⽇ 志传送到安全账户的 S3 存储桶，符合集中化存储需求。
explanations.E: 在每个账户中启 ⽤ AWS CloudTrail 。配置 ⽇ 志将传送到组织管理账户中创建的 Amazon S3 存储桶。使 ⽤ AWS Lambda 和 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 将 ⽇ 志转发到专 ⻔ 安全账户中的 S3 存储 桶。 错误 : 需要在每个账户中单独启 ⽤ CloudTrail ，增加了操作开销。 错误 : 使 ⽤ Lambda 和 Kinesis Data Firehose 转发 ⽇ 志增加了额外的复杂性，不符合 “ 最 少操作开销 ” 的要求

question: A company is testing its incident response plan for compromised credentials. The company runs a database on an Amazon EC2 instance and stores the sensitive database credentials as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. The secret has rotation configured with an AWS Lambda function that uses the generic rotation function template. The EC2 instance and the Lambda function are deployed in the same private subnet. The VPC has a Secrets Manager VPC endpoint. A security engineer discovers that the secret cannot rotate. The security engineer determines that the VPC endpoint is working as intended. The Amazon CloudWatch logs contain the following error: "setSecret: Unable to log into database". Which solution will resolve this error?

options.A: Use the AWS Management Console to edit the JSON structure of the secret in Secrets Manager so that the secret automatically conforms with the structure that the database requires.
options.B: Ensure that the security group that is attached to the Lambda function allows outbound connections to the EC2 instance. Ensure that the security group that is attached to the EC2 instance allows inbound connections from the security group that is attached to the Lambda function.
options.C: Use the Secrets Manager list-secrets command in the AWS CLI to list the secret. Identify the database credentials. Use the Secrets Manager rotate- secret command in the AWS CLI to force the immediate rotation of the secret.
options.D: Add an internet gateway to the VPC. Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet. Update the VPC route tables so that traffic from the Lambda function and traffic from the EC2 instance can reach the Secrets Manager public endpoint.

explanations.A: 函数与 EC2 实例之间的 ⽹ 络通信。 2. 选项分析 A. 使 ⽤ AWS Management Console 编辑 Secrets Manager 中 secret 的 JSON 结 构，以便该 secret ⾃ 动符合数据库所需的结构。 错误原因 : 题 ⽬ 中提到的错误是 “ ⽆ 法登录到数据库 ” ，这表明问题出在 ⽹ 络连接或认证 上， ⽽ 不是 Secrets Manager 的 JSON 结构。编辑 JSON 结构 ⽆ 法解决 ⽹ 络连接问题。
explanations.B: 确保附加到 Lambda 函数的安全组允许到 EC2 实例的出站连接。确保附加到 EC2 实例的安全组允许来 ⾃ 附加到 Lambda 函数的安全组的 ⼊ 站连接。 正确原因 : 根据错误 ⽇ 志 “setSecret: Unable to log into database” ，问题可能是 Lambda 函数 ⽆ 法连接到数据库。确保安全组配置正确，允许 Lambda 函数与 EC2 实例 之间的通信，可以解决此问题。
explanations.C: 使 ⽤ AWS CLI 中的 Secrets Manager list-secrets 命令列出 secret 。识别数据库 凭证。使 ⽤ AWS CLI 中的 Secrets Manager rotate-secret 命令强制 ⽴ 即轮换该 secret 。 错误原因 : 强制轮换密钥并不能解决 ⽹ 络连接问题。问题的根本原因是 Lambda 函数 ⽆ 法登录到数据库， ⽽ 不是 Secrets Manager 的轮换机制。
explanations.D: 向 VPC 添加 ⼀ 个 internet gateway 。在公共 ⼦ ⽹ 中创建 ⼀ 个 NAT gateway 。更新 VPC 路由表，以便 Lambda 函数的流量和 EC2 实例的流量可以访问 Secrets Manager 的公共 endpoint 。 错误原因 : 题 ⽬ 中明确提到 VPC 已经配置了 Secrets Manager 的 VPC endpoint ，因此 不需要通过公共 endpoint 访问 Secrets Manager 。添加 NAT ⽹ 关和 Internet Gateway 是多余的。

question: A company has deployed a set of standard IAM roles in its AWS accounts. The IAM roles are based on the job functions within the company. To balance operational efficiency and security, a security engineer has implemented AWS Organizations SCPs to restrict access to critical security services in all company accounts. All accounts and OUs in AWS Organizations have the default FullAWSAccess SCP attached. The security engineer needs to ensure that no one can disable Amazon GuardDuty and AWS Security Hub. The security engineer must also ensure that the other permissions granted by IAM policies in the accounts are not overridden. Which SCP should the security engineer attach to the root of the organization to meet these requirements?

options.A: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Deny", "Action": [ "guardduty:DeleteDetector", "guardduty:UpdateDetector", "securityhub:DisableSecurityHub" ], "Resource": [ "*" ] } ] }
options.B: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Deny", "Action": "*", "Resource": "*" }, { "Effect": "Allow", "NotAction": [ "guardduty:DeleteDetector", "guardduty:UpdateDetector", "securityhub:DisableSecurityHub" ], "Resource": [ "*" ] } ] }
options.C: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": "*", "Resource": "*" }, { "Effect": "Deny", "NotAction": [ "guardduty:DeleteDetector", "guardduty:UpdateDetector", "securityhub:DisableSecurityHub" ], "Resource": [ "*" ] } ] }
options.D: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "NotAction": [ "guardduty:DeleteDetector", "guardduty:UpdateDetector", "securityhub:DisableSecurityHub" ], "Resource": [ "*" ] } ] }

explanations.A: Correct. This SCP explicitly denies the disable operations for GuardDuty and Security Hub (DeleteDetector, UpdateDetector, DisableSecurityHub) without affecting any other permissions. Since the default FullAWSAccess SCP already grants all permissions, this additional Deny SCP only blocks specific dangerous actions without overriding other IAM policy permissions.
explanations.B: Incorrect. This option first denies all actions (Deny *), then attempts to restore permissions using Allow + NotAction. However, in SCPs, explicit Deny takes precedence over Allow, so the first statement denies all actions and the second Allow statement cannot override the Deny, resulting in all actions being denied.
explanations.C: Incorrect. This option first allows all actions, then uses Deny + NotAction to deny all actions except the GuardDuty/Security Hub operations. NotAction means 'actions not in the list', so this would deny everything except these three actions — the exact opposite of the intended effect.
explanations.D: Incorrect. This option uses Allow + NotAction, meaning it allows all actions except the GuardDuty/Security Hub operations. question: A company has AWS accounts that are in an organization in AWS Organizations. An Amazon S3 bucket in one of the accounts is publicly accessible. explanations.A: 配置 S3 bucket 使 ⽤ AWS KMS 密钥并强制加密，配置 SCP 拒绝 s3 GetObject 操 作。 错误：虽然加密可以保护数据，但它与防 ⽌ 公共访问 ⽆ 关。加密不会阻 ⽌ S3 bucket 被设置为公开访问。 错误： SCP 拒绝 s3 GetObject 操作会阻 ⽌ 数据读取，但 ⽆ 法防 ⽌ bucket 被设置为 公开访问。

explanations.C: 启 ⽤ S3 bucket 的 PublicAccessBlock 配置，配置 SCP 拒绝 s3 PutPublicAccessBlock 操作。 正确： PublicAccessBlock 配置可以防 ⽌ 当前的公共访问。 正确： SCP 拒绝 s3 PutPublicAccessBlock 操作可以防 ⽌ ⽤ 户禁 ⽤ PublicAccessBlock ，从 ⽽ 确保 bucket ⽆ 法被设置为公开访问。

question: A company needs a solution to protect critical data from being permanently deleted. The data is stored in Amazon S3 buckets. The company needs to replicate the S3 objects from the company's primary AWS Region to a secondary Region to meet disaster recovery requirements. The company must also ensure that users who have administrator access cannot permanently delete the data in the secondary Region.Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Backup to perform cross-Region S3 backups. Select a backup vault in the secondary Region. Enable AWS Backup Vault Lock in governance mode for the backups in the secondary Region.
options.B: Implement S3 Object Lock in compliance mode in the primary Region. Configure S3 replication to replicate the objects to an S3 bucket in the secondary Region.
options.C: Configure S3 replication to replicate the objects to an S3 bucket in the secondary Region. Create an S3 bucket policy to deny the s3 ReplicateDelete action on the S3 bucket in the secondary Region.
options.D: Configure S3 replication to replicate the objects to an S3 bucket in the secondary Region. Configure S3 object versioning on the S3 bucket in the secondary Region.

explanations.A: 正确性分析：虽然 AWS Backup Vault Lock 可以防 ⽌ 备份被删除，但它是针对备 份数据的， ⽽ 不是直接针对 S3 存储桶中 的对象。此外，治理模式允许管理员绕过保护，这不符合题 ⽬ 要求 “ 确保 ⽤ 户（包 括管理员）不能永久删除数据 ” 。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 正确性分析：使 ⽤ S3 Object Lock 的合规模式可以防 ⽌ 任何 ⽤ 户（包括管理员） 删除数据。通过跨区域复制（ S3Replication ） ，可以将数据复制到次要区域的存储 桶中，从 ⽽ 满 ⾜ 灾难恢复需求。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: 正确性分析：虽然可以通过存储桶策略拒绝 s3 ReplicateDelete 操作，但这并不能 防 ⽌ 管理员直接删除数据。此外，存储桶策略可以被管理员修改，因此不符合题 ⽬ 要求 “ 确保 ⽤ 户（包括管理员）不能永久删除数据 ” 。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 正确性分析：启 ⽤ 版本控制可以防 ⽌ 数据被永久删除，但管理员仍然可以删除所有 版本的对象。此外，版本控制并不能完全满 ⾜ 题 ⽬

question: A security engineer is configuring AWS Config for an AWS account that uses a new IAM entity. When the security engineer tries to configure AWS Config rules and automatic remediation options, errors occur. In the AWS CloudTrail logs, the security engineer sees the following error message: “Insufficient delivery policy to s3 bucket: DOC EXAMPLE BUCKET, unable to write to bucket, provided s3 key prefix is ‘null ʼ .” Which combination of steps should the security engineer take to remediate this issue? Choose two.)

options.A: Check the Amazon S3 bucket policy. Verify that the policy allows the config amazonaws,com service to write to the target bucket.
options.B: Verify that the IAM entity has the permissions necessary to perform the s3 GetBucketAcl and s3 PutObject* operations to write to the target bucket.
options.C: Verify that the Amazon S3 bucket policy has the permissions necessary to perform the s3 GetBucketAcl and s3 PutObject* operations to write to the target bucket.
options.D: Check the policy that is associated with the IAM entity. Verify that the policy allows the config.amazonaws.com service to write to the target bucket.
options.E: Verify that the AWS Config service role has permissions to invoke the BatchGetResourceConfig action instead of the GetResourceConfigHistory action and s3 PutObject* operation.

explanations.A: 检查 Amazon S3 存储桶策略。验证该策略是否允许 config.amazonaws.com 服务写 ⼊ ⽬ 标存储桶。 正确。 AWS Config 需要将配置记录写 ⼊ 到指定的 S3 存储桶，存储桶策略必须允许 config.amazonaws.com 服务写 ⼊ ⽬ 标存 储桶。如果存储桶策略没有正确配置，会导致写 ⼊ 失败。
explanations.B: 验证 IAM 实体是否具有执 ⾏ s3 GetBucketAcl 和 s3 PutObject* 操作以写 ⼊ ⽬ 标存储桶所需的权限。 正确。 IAM 实体需要具备 ⾜ 够的权限来执 ⾏ s3 GetBucketAcl 和 s3 PutObject 操 作，以便 AWS Config 能够成功写 ⼊ ⽬ 标存储 桶。
explanations.C: 验证 Amazon S3 存储桶策略是否具有执 ⾏ s3 GetBucketAcl 和 s3 PutObject 操作以写 ⼊ ⽬ 标存储桶所需的权限。 错误。存储桶策略主要 ⽤ 于控制外部服务（如 AWS Config ）对存储桶的访问， ⽽ 不是直接验证 IAM 实体的权限。
explanations.D: 检查与 IAM 实体关联的策略。验证该策略是否允许 config.amazonaws.com 服务写 ⼊ ⽬ 标存储桶。 错误。 IAM 实体的权限是针对 ⽤ 户或 ⾓ ⾊ 的， ⽽ 不是直接针对 config.amazonaws.com 服务。此选项混淆了 IAM 实体权限 与服务权限的概念。
explanations.E: 验证 AWS Config 服务 ⾓ ⾊ 是否具有调 ⽤ BatchGetResourceConfig 操作 ⽽ 不 是 GetResourceConfigHistory 操作以及 s3 PutObject* 操作的权限。 错误。题 ⽬ 中提到的问题是与 S3 存储桶写 ⼊ 权限相关， ⽽ 不是与 AWS Config 服务 ⾓ ⾊ 调 ⽤ 的 API 操作相关。

question: A company wants to implement host-based security for Amazon EC2 instances and containers in Amazon Elastic Container Registry Amazon ECR . The company has deployed AWS Systems Manager Agent SSM Agent) on the EC2 instances. All the company's AWS accounts are in one organization in AWS Organizations. The company will analyze the workloads for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure. The company will push any findings to AWS Security Hub, which the company has configured for the organization. The company must deploy the solution to all member accounts, including new accounts, automatically. When new workloads come online, the solution must scan the workloads. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use SCPs to configure scanning of EC2 instances and ECR containers for all accounts in the organization.
options.B: Configure a delegated administrator for Amazon GuardDuty for the organization. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to initiate analysis of ECR containers
options.C: Configure a delegated administrator for Amazon Inspector for the organization. Configure automatic scanning for new member accounts.
options.D: Configure a delegated administrator for Amazon Inspector for the organization. Create an AWS Config rule to initiate analysis of ECR containers

explanations.A: 使 ⽤ SCPs 为组织中的所有账户配置 EC2 实例和 ECR 容器的扫描。 错误原因：服务控制策略（ SCPs ） ⽤ 于限制或允许账户的操作权限，但它不能直 接 ⽤ 于配置或执 ⾏ 扫描任务。 SCPs ⽆ 法满 ⾜ 题 ⽬ 中关于 ⾃ 动扫描和推送结果到 Security Hub 的需求。
explanations.B: 。 ⾃ 动化部署解决 ⽅ 案以覆盖所有成员账户和新账户。 选项分析 A. 使 ⽤ SCPs 为组织中的所有账户配置 EC2 实例和 ECR 容器的扫描。 错误原因：服务控制策略（ SCPs ） ⽤ 于限制或允许账户的操作权限，但它不能直 接 ⽤ 于配置或执 ⾏ 扫描任务。 SCPs ⽆ 法满 ⾜ 题 ⽬ 中关于 ⾃ 动扫描和推送结果到 Security Hub 的需求。 B. 为组织配置 Amazon GuardDuty 的委派管理员。创建 ⼀ 个 Amazon EventBridge 规则以启动对 ECR 容器的分析。 错误原因： Amazon GuardDuty 主要 ⽤ 于检测恶意活动和异常 ⾏ 为， ⽽ 不是专 ⻔ 设计 ⽤ 于漏洞扫描或分析 ECR 容器。虽 然 EventBridge 可以触发事件，但这不是最佳解决 ⽅ 案。
explanations.C: 为组织配置 Amazon Inspector 的委派管理员。为新成员账户配置 ⾃ 动扫描。 正确原因： Amazon Inspector 专 ⻔ ⽤ 于漏洞扫描和分析，包括 EC2 实例和 ECR 容 器。通过配置委派管理员，可以集中管理所有成员账户的扫描任务。 Amazon Inspector ⽀ 持 ⾃ 动扫描新账户和新 ⼯ 作负载，并将结果推送到 Security Hub 。
explanations.D: 为组织配置 Amazon Inspector 的委派管理员。创建 ⼀ 个 AWS Config 规则以 启动对 ECR 容器的分析。 错误原因：虽然 AWS Config 可以监控资源配置的合规性，但它不是专 ⻔ 设计 ⽤ 于 启动漏洞扫描任务。相 ⽐ 之下， Amazon Inspector 已经内置了 ⾃ 动扫描功能， ⽆ 需额外创建 Config 规则。

question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage several AWS accounts. The company processes a large volume of sensitive data. The company uses a serverless approach to microservices. The company stores all the data in either Amazon S3 or Amazon DynamoDB. The company reads the data by using either AWS Lambda functions or container-based services that the company hosts on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service Amazon EKS) on AWS Fargate. The company must implement a solution to encrypt all the data at rest and enforce least privilege data access controls. The company creates an AWS Key Management Service AWS KMS) customer managed key. What should the company do next to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a key policy that allows the kms:Decrypt action only for Amazon S3 and DynamoDB. Create an SCP that denies the creation of S3 buckets and DynamoDB tables that are not encrypted with the key.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that denies the kms:Decrypt action for the key. Create a Lambda function than runs on a schedule to attach the policy to any new roles. Create an AWS Config rule to send alerts for resources that are not encrypted with the key.
options.C: Create a key policy that allows the kms:Decrypt action only for Amazon S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, and Amazon EKS. Create an SCP that denies the creation of S3 buckets and DynamoDB tables that are not encrypted with the key.
options.D: Create a key policy that allows the kms:Decrypt action only for Amazon S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, and Amazon EKS. Create an AWS Config rule to send alerts for resources that are not encrypted with the key.

explanations.A: 创建 ⼀ 个密钥策略，仅允许对 Amazon S3 和 DynamoD
explanations.B: 执 ⾏ kms:Decrypt 操作。创建 ⼀ 个 SCP ，拒绝创建未使 ⽤ 该密钥加密的 S3 存储桶和 DynamoDB 表。 正确性：此选项部分正确，因为它限制了对 S3 和 DynamoDB 的解密操作，并通 过 SCP 强制加密要求。 问题： 未考虑 Lambda 和 Amazon EKS 的解密需求，违反了题 ⽬ 中提到的 “ 公司 使 ⽤ Lambda 和 Amazon EKS 读取数据 ” 的 要求。 B. 创建 ⼀ 个 IAM 策略，拒绝对密钥执 ⾏ kms:Decrypt 操作。创建 ⼀ 个按计划运 ⾏ 的 Lambda 函数，将该策略附加到任何新 ⾓ ⾊ 上。创建 ⼀ 个 AWS Config 规 则，以发送未使 ⽤ 该密钥加密的资源的警报。 正确性：此选项不符合题 ⽬ 要求，因为 IAM 策略 ⽆ 法跨账户强制执 ⾏ 加密要求， 且使 ⽤ Lambda 函数动态附加策略的 ⽅ 式复杂且不可靠。 问题：未提到如何限制 S3 和 DynamoDB 的加密要求，且未直接实现最 ⼩ 权限原 则。
explanations.C: 创建 ⼀ 个密钥策略，仅允许对 Amazon S3 、 DynamoDB 、 Lambda 和 Amazon EKS 执 ⾏ kms:Decrypt 操作。创建 ⼀ 个 SCP ，拒绝创建未使 ⽤ 该密钥 加密的 S3 存储桶和 DynamoDB 表。 正确性：此选项正确地限制了解密操作，仅允许 S3 、 DynamoDB 、 Lambda 和 Amazon EKS 使 ⽤ 密钥，同时通过 SCP 强制加密要求。 问题： ⽆ 明显问题，完全符合题 ⽬ 要求。
explanations.D: 创建 ⼀ 个密钥策略，仅允许对 Amazon S3 、 DynamoDB 、 Lambda 和 Amazon EKS 执 ⾏ kms:Decrypt 操作。创建 ⼀ 个 AWS Config 规则，以发送未使 ⽤ 该密钥加密的资源的警报。 正确性：此选项部分正确，因为它限制了解密操作，并通过 AWS Config 规则监 控加密状态。问题： AWS Config 规则只能发送警报， ⽆ 法强制执 ⾏ 加密要求，因 此不如 SCP 有效。

question: An AWS Lambda function was misused to alter data, and a security engineer must identify who invoked the function and what output was produced. The engineer cannot find any logs created by the Lambda function in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Which of the following explains why the logs are not available?

options.A: The execution role for the Lambda function did not grant permissions to write log data to CloudWatch Logs.
options.B: The Lambda function was invoked by using Amazon API Gateway, so the logs are not stored in CloudWatch Logs.
options.C: The execution role for the Lambda function did not grant permissions to write to the Amazon S3 bucket where CloudWatch Logs stores the logs.
options.D: The version of the Lambda function that was invoked was not current.

explanations.A: 与 CloudWatch Logs 的集成，以及 Lambda 执 ⾏ ⾓ ⾊ 的权限配置。 了解 Lambda 函数如何将 ⽇ 志写 ⼊ CloudWatch Logs ，以及相关 IAM 权限的要求。 选项分析 A. 正确。 Lambda 函数需要通过其执 ⾏ ⾓ ⾊ 拥有写 ⼊ CloudWatch Logs 的权限。 如果执 ⾏ ⾓ ⾊ 未授予 logs:CreateLogGroup 和 logs:CreateLogStream 以及 logs:PutLogEvents 权限， ⽇ 志将 ⽆ 法写 ⼊ CloudWatch Logs 。
explanations.B: 错误。即使 Lambda 函数是通过 API Gateway 调 ⽤ 的， Lambda 函数的 ⽇ 志仍然 会写 ⼊ CloudWatch Logs （前提是权限正确） 。 API Gateway 的调 ⽤ 不会改变 ⽇ 志存储的默认 ⾏ 为。
explanations.C: 错误。 CloudWatch Logs 的 ⽇ 志存储在 CloudWatch Logs 服务中， ⽽ 不是直接 存储在 Amazon S3 中。此选项混淆了 CloudWatch Logs 与 S3 的存储机制。
explanations.D: The version of the Lambda function that was invoked was not current. 错 误。 Lambda 函数的版本不会影响 ⽇ 志写 ⼊ CloudWatch Logs 的 ⾏ 为。只要执 ⾏ ⾓ ⾊ 的权限正确，任何版本的 Lambda 函数都可以写 ⼊ ⽇ 志。

question: A company has AWS accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company uses AWS Systems Manager for software inventory and patching operations. A security engineer must implement a solution that detects EC2 instances that do not have the required software. Configure the EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function that uses Systems Manager Run Command to install the required software.

question: A company needs to create a centralized solution to analyze log files. The company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage its AWS accounts. The solution must aggregate and normalize events from the following sources: • The entire organization in Organizations • All AWS Marketplace offerings that run in the company ʼ s AWS accounts • The company's on-premises systems Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure a centralized Amazon S3 bucket for the logs. Enable VPC Flow Logs, AWS CloudTrail. and Amazon Route 53logs in all accounts. Configure all accounts to use the centralized S3 bucket. Configure AWS Glue crawlers to parse the logfiles. Use Amazon Athena to query the log data.
options.B: Configure log streams in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the sources that need monitoring Create log subscription filters for each log stream. Forward the messages to Amazon OpenSearch Service for analysis.
options.C: Set up a delegated Amazon Security Lake administrator account in Organizations. Enable and configure Security Lake for the organization. Add the accounts that need monitoring. Use Amazon Athena to query the log data.
options.D: Apply an SCP to configure all member accounts and services to deliver log files to a centralized Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to query the centralized S3 bucket for log entries.

explanations.A: ） 选项分析 A. 配置 ⼀ 个集中化的 Amazon S3 存储桶 ⽤ 于 ⽇ 志。 正确性分析：此选项提到使 ⽤ Amazon S3 集中存储 ⽇ 志，并使 ⽤ AWS Glue 和 Amazon Athena 进 ⾏ 查询。这种 ⽅ 法可以实 现 ⽇ 志的集中化存储和分析，但它没有提到如何处理 AWS Marketplace 和本地系 统的 ⽇ 志，也没有提到如何规范化事件 数据。 结论：部分正确，但不完全满 ⾜ 题 ⽬ 要求。
explanations.B: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch Logs ⽇ 志流。 正确性分析：此选项提到使 ⽤ CloudWatch Logs 和 Amazon OpenSearch Service 进 ⾏ ⽇ 志分析，但 CloudWatch Logs 主要 ⽤ 于实时监控和分析， ⽽ 不是集 中化存储和规范化事件数据。此外，它没有提到如何处理 AWS Marketplace 和本 地系统的 ⽇ 志。 结论：不完全满 ⾜ 题 ⽬ 要求。
explanations.C: 设置 ⼀ 个委托的 Amazon Security Lake 管理员账户。 正确性分析：此选项提到使 ⽤ Amazon Security Lake ，这是 ⼀ 个专 ⻔ 设计 ⽤ 于集 中化 ⽇ 志管理和分析的服务。它 ⽀ 持从多个来源（包括 AWS 服务、 AWS Marketplace 和本地系统）收集、规范化和分析 ⽇ 志数据，并与 Amazon Athena 集成进 ⾏ 查询。 结论：完全满 ⾜ 题 ⽬ 要求，是正确答案。
explanations.D: 应 ⽤ SCP 以配置所有成员账户和服务。 正确性分析：此选项提到使 ⽤ SCP （ Service Control Policies ）来强制 ⽇ 志传送 到集中化的 S3 存储桶，并使 ⽤ Amazon OpenSearch Service 进 ⾏ 查询。虽然 SCP 可以强制执 ⾏ 策略，但它 ⽆ 法直接处理 ⽇ 志的规范化和分析。此外，它没有提 到如何处理 AWS Marketplace 和本地系统的 ⽇ 志。 结论：不完全满 ⾜ 题 ⽬ 要求。

question: A company uses AWS Organizations. The company has more than 100 AWS accounts and will increase the number of accounts. The company also uses an external corporate identity provider IdP . The company needs to provide users with role-based access to the accounts. The solution must maximize scalability andoperational efficiency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: In each account, create a set of dedicated IAM users. Ensure that all users assume these IAM users through federation with the existing IdP.
options.B: Deploy an IAM role in a central identity account. Allow users to assume the role through federation with the existing IdP. In each account, deploy a set of IAM roles that match the desired access patterns. Include a trust policy that allows access from the central identity account. Edit the permissions policy for the role in each account to match user access requirements.
options.C: Enable AWS IAM Identity Center. Integrate IAM Identity Center with the company's existing IdP. Create permission sets that match the desired access patterns. Assign permissions to match user access requirements.
options.D: In each account, deploy a set of IAM roles that match the desired access patterns. Create a trust policy with the existingIdP. Update each role's permissions policy to use SAML-based IAM condition keys that are based on user access requirements.

explanations.A: 在每个账户中创建 ⼀ 组专 ⽤ 的 IAM ⽤ 户。确保所有 ⽤ 户通过与现有 IdP 的联合 ⾝ 份验证来使 ⽤ 这些 IAM ⽤ 户。 错误原因： 创建专 ⽤ 的 IAM ⽤ 户在每个账户中会导致管理复杂性，尤其是当账户数量增加时， ⽆ 法满 ⾜ “ 最 ⼤ 化可扩展性和操作效 率 ” 的要求。 使 ⽤ IAM ⽤ 户 ⽽ 不是 IAM ⾓ ⾊ 或集中式 ⾝ 份管理解决 ⽅ 案不符合最佳实践。
explanations.B: 在 ⼀ 个中央 ⾝ 份账户中部署 ⼀ 个 IAM ⾓ ⾊ 。允许 ⽤ 户通过与现有 IdP 的联合 ⾝ 份验证来使 ⽤ 该 ⾓ ⾊ 。在每个 账户中部署 ⼀ 组与所需访问模式匹配的 IAM ⾓ ⾊ 。包含允许从中央 ⾝ 份账户访问 的信任策略。编辑每个账户中 ⾓ ⾊ 的权限策略以匹配 ⽤ 户访问需求。 错误原因： 虽然这种 ⽅ 法可以实现跨账户访问，但需要在每个账户中 ⼿ 动部署 IAM ⾓ ⾊ 并配置 信任策略，操作效率较低。 随着账户数量增加，管理这些 ⾓ ⾊ 的复杂性会显著增加，不符合 “ 最 ⼤ 化可扩展性 ” 的要求。
explanations.C: 启 ⽤ AWS IAM Identity Center 。将 IAM Identity Center 与公司的现有 IdP 集 成。创建与所需访问模式匹配的权限 集。分配权限以匹配 ⽤ 户访问需求。 正确原因： AWS IAM Identity Center （原 AWS SSO ）是专 ⻔ 设计 ⽤ 于集中管理 ⽤ 户访问的 服务， ⽀ 持与外部 IdP 集成。 通过权限集，可以轻松定义和分配基于 ⾓ ⾊ 的访问权限，满 ⾜ “ 最 ⼤ 化可扩展性和 操作效率 ” 的要求。 IAM Identity Center ⽀ 持 ⾃ 动扩展，适合管理 ⼤ 量账户和 ⽤ 户。
explanations.D: 在每个账户中部署 ⼀ 组与所需访问模式匹配的 IAM ⾓ ⾊ 。创建 ⼀ 个与现有 IdP 的信任策略。更新每个 ⾓ ⾊ 的 权限策略以使 ⽤ 基于 SAML 的 IAM 条件键，这些条件键基于 ⽤ 户访问需求。 错误原因： 这种 ⽅ 法需要在每个账户中 ⼿ 动部署 IAM ⾓ ⾊ 并配置信任策略，操作效率较低。 基于 SAML 的 IAM 条件键虽然可以实现细粒度的访问控制，但管理复杂性较 ⾼ ，不 符合 “ 最 ⼤ 化可扩展性 ” 的要求。

question: A company has a web-based application that runs behind an Application Load Balancer ALB . The application is experiencing a credential stuffing attack that is producing many failed login attempts. The attack is coming from many IP addresses. Thelogin attempts are using a user agent string of a known mobile device emulator. A security engineer needs to implement a solution to mitigate the credential stuffing attack. The solution must still allow legitimate logins to the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that reacts to login attempts that contain the specified user agent string Add an Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon SNS) topic to the alarm.
options.B: Modify the inbound security group on the ALB to deny traffic from the IP addresses that are involved in the attack.

question: A machine learning engineer at a company is creating a classification model. While browsing the dataset, the engineer notices a field named day_of_week. The data in this column contains the following values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Which technique should the engineer use to convert the data in this column to binary values?

options.A: Binary encoding
options.B: Label encoding
options.C: One-hot encoding
options.D: Tokenization

explanations.A: Binary Encoding converts categories to numerical values (e.g., 1, 2, 3), then to binary codes (e.g., 01, 10, 11). While it produces fewer feature dimensions than one-hot encoding, it is less intuitive and less commonly used for data with only 7 categories like days of the week.
explanations.B: Label Encoding assigns integers to categories (0, 1, 2...). This causes the model to incorrectly assume an ordinal relationship between values (e.g., Sunday=6 is more important than Monday=0), which negatively impacts most classification models (e.g., linear regression, SVM).
explanations.C: Correct. One-Hot Encoding creates a new dummy variable for each category with values of 0 or 1. For example, "Monday" becomes [1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]. This is the most standard technique for handling unordered categorical data and prevents the model from misinterpreting numerical magnitude.
explanations.D: Tokenization is a Natural Language Processing (NLP) technique used to split long sentences into individual words or tokens. It is a preliminary step for text processing, not an encoding technique for converting categorical fields to binary values.

question: A machine learning engineer wants to use Amazon SageMaker AI to prepare training data. During exploratory data analysis, the engineer discovers that some categorical features have missing values. How can the engineer use SageMaker AI to resolve this issue?

options.A: Use SageMaker Clarify to impute categorical features based on mean values.
options.B: Use SageMaker Clarify to infer categorical features using mode values.
options.C: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to impute categorical features using mean values.
options.D: Use SageMaker Data Wrangler to impute categorical features using mode values.

explanations.A: SageMaker Clarify is primarily used for detecting data bias and providing model explainability, not as a general-purpose data preprocessing tool. Additionally, mean values are not applicable to categorical data.
explanations.B: Clarify is not the primary tool for performing data imputation. While mode is appropriate for categorical data, the tool choice is incorrect.
explanations.C: SageMaker Data Wrangler is the correct tool (designed for data preparation and feature engineering), but mean values can only be used for numerical data (e.g., height, weight) and cannot compute the mean of categories (e.g., colors, cities).
explanations.D: Correct. SageMaker Data Wrangler provides built-in transformation capabilities to handle missing values. For categorical features, the most common and reasonable imputation method is using the mode, which is the most frequently occurring value in that column.

question: A company that uses AWS Organizations is migrating workloads to AWS. explanations.A: 正确。通过在管理员账户中创建 CloudFormation 模板并使 ⽤ StackSets 共享给应 ⽤ 账户，可以确保所有资源通过标准化模板进 ⾏ 部署。这符合要求中 “ 所有基础设 施必须通过 CloudFormation 模板部署 ” 的规定。

options.C: In the Account B VPC, create an interface VPC endpoint for AWS KMS. For the interface VPC endpoint, create a resource policy that allows the kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, and kms:GenerateDataKey actions for the KMS key. Ensure that privateDNS is turned on for the endpoint.
options.D: In the Account B VPC, create an interface VPC endpoint for AWS KMS. For the interface VPC endpoint, create a resource policy that allows the kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, and kms:GenerateDataKey actions for the KMS key. Ensure that private DNS is turned off for the endpoint.
options.E: In the Account B VPC, verify that the S3 bucket policy allows the s3 PutObjectAcl action for cross-account use. In the Account B VPC, create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. question: A security engineer is designing an IAM policy for a script that will use the AWS CLI. The script currently assumes an IAM role that is attached to three AWS managed IAM policies: AmazonEC2FullAccess, AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess, and AmazonVPCFullAccess. The security engineer needs to construct a least privilege IAM policy that will replace the AWS managed IAM policies that are attached to this role. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: In AWS CloudTrail, create a trail for management events. Run the script with the existing AWS managed IAM policies. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate a new IAM policy that is based on access activity in the trail. Replace the existing AWS managed IAM policies with the generated IAM policy for the role.
options.B: Remove the existing AWS managed IAM policies from the role. Attach the IAM Access Analyzer Role Policy Generator to the role. Run the script. Return to IAM Access Analyzer and generate a least privilege IAM policy. Attach the new IAM policy to the role.
options.C: Create an account analyzer in IAM Access Analyzer. Create an archive rule that has a filter that checks whether the PrincipalArn value matches the ARN of the role. Run the script. Remove the existing AWS managed IAM policies from the role.
options.D: In AWS CloudTrail, create a trail for management events. Remove the existing AWS managed IAM policies from the role. Run the script. Find the authorization failure in the trail event that is associated with the script. Create a new IAM policy that includes the action and resource that caused the authorization failure. Repeat the process until the script succeeds. Attach the new IAM policy to the role.

explanations.A: 正确。此选项使 ⽤ AWS CloudTrail 记录管理事件，并结合 IAM Access Analyzer ⽣ 成基于 实际访问活动的最 ⼩ 权限 IAM 策略。这种 ⽅ 法 ⾼ 效且符合最 ⼩ 权限原则。

question: A company has two AWS accounts: Account A and Account B. Account A has an IAM role that IAM users in Account B assume when they need to upload sensitive documents to Amazon S3 buckets in Account A. A new requirement mandates that users can assume the role only if they are authenticated with multi-factor authentication MFA . A security engineer must recommend a solution that meets this requirement with minimum risk and effort. Which solution should the security engineer recommend?

options.B: Add an aws MultiFactorAuthPresent condition to the role ʼ s trust policy.

question: A company wants to receive automated email notifications when AWS access keys from developer AWS accounts are detected on code repository sites. Which solution will provide the required email notifications?

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to send Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon SNS) email notifications for Amazon GuardDuty UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/lnstanceCredentialExfiltration.OutsideAWS findings.
options.B: Change the AWS account contact information for the Operations type to a separate email address. Periodically poll this email address for notifications.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS Health events that have a value of Risk for the service category. Configure email notifications by using Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon SNS .
options.D: Implement new anomaly detection software. Ingest AWS CloudTrail logs. Configure monitoring for ConsoleLogin events in the AWS Management Console. Configure email notifications from the anomaly detection software.

explanations.A: 正确： Amazon GuardDuty 可以检测 IAM ⽤ 户凭证泄露的情况，并 ⽣ 成相关的安全 发现（例如 UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/InstanceCredentialExfiltration.OutsideAWS ） 。 正确： Amazon EventBridge 可以监听 GuardDuty 的发现事件，并触发 Amazon SNS 发送电 ⼦ 邮件通知。此选项完全符合题 ⽬ 要求。
explanations.B: 错误：更改账户联系信息并轮询电 ⼦ 邮件地址 ⽆ 法实现 ⾃ 动化通知，且与题 ⽬ 要求 的 “ 检测开发者账户访问密钥泄露 ” ⽆ 关。 此选项不涉及 GuardDuty 或 EventBridge ， ⽆ 法满 ⾜ 题 ⽬ 需求。
explanations.C: 错误： AWS Health 事件主要 ⽤ 于报告账户级别的服务健康状况，与检测访问密钥 泄露 ⽆ 关。此选项未提及 GuardDuty 或相关的安全发现， ⽆ 法满 ⾜ 题 ⽬ 需求。
explanations.D: 错误：此选项提到的异常检测软件和 CloudTrail ⽇ 志分析是 ⼀ 个复杂的解决 ⽅ 案， 但题 ⽬ 要求的是针对访问密钥泄露的 ⾃ 动化通知。 此选项未提及 GuardDuty 或 EventBridge ，且实现起来复杂度较 ⾼ ，不符合题 ⽬ 需 求。

question: A company deployed an Amazon EC2 instance to a VPC on AWS. A recent alert indicates that the EC2 instance is receiving a suspicious number of requests over an open TCP port from an external source. The TCP port remains open for long periods of time. The company's security team needs to stop all activity to this port from the external source to ensure that the EC2 instance is not being compromised. The application must remain available to other users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Update the network ACL that is attached to the subnet that is associated with the EC2 instance. Add a Deny statement for the port and the source IP addresses.
options.B: Update the elastic network interface security group that is attached to the EC2 instance to remove the port from the inbound rule list.
options.C: Update the elastic network interface security group that is attached to the EC2 instance by adding a Deny entry in the inbound list for the port and the source IP addresses.
options.D: Create a new network ACL for the subnet. Deny all traffic from the EC2 instance to prevent data from being removed

explanations.A: 正确： ⽹ 络 ACL 可以显式地添加 “Deny” 规则，阻 ⽌ 特定端 ⼝ 和源 IP 地址的流量。这是 解决问题的最佳 ⽅ 法，因为它可以精确地阻 ⽌ 恶意流量，同时允许其他流量正常通 过。
explanations.B: 错误：移除端 ⼝ 会阻 ⽌ 所有流量， ⽽ 不仅仅是来 ⾃ 恶意源的流量。这不符合题 ⽬ 要 求，因为应 ⽤ 需要保持对其他 ⽤ 户 的可 ⽤ 性。
explanations.C: 错误：安全组不 ⽀ 持显式的 “Deny” 规则，只能通过允许规则来控制流量。因此，这个 选项在技术上不可 ⾏ 。
explanations.D: 错误：拒绝所有流量会导致应 ⽤ 不可 ⽤ ，这与题 ⽬ 要求的 “ 应 ⽤ 必须保持可 ⽤ 性 ” 相 ⽭ 盾。

question: A company has secured the AWS account root user for its AWS account by following AWS best practices. The company also has enabled AWS CloudTrail, which is sending its logs to Amazon S3. A security engineer wants to receive notification in near-real time if a user uses the AWS account root user credentials to sign in to the AWS Management Console Which solutions will provide this notification? Choose two.)

Configure the rule to target an Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe any required endpoints to the SNS topic so that these endpoints can receive notification.

question: A company is storing data in Amazon S3 Glacier. A security engineer implemented a new vault lock policy for 10 TB of data and called the initiate- vault-lock operation 12 hours ago. options.A: Call the abort-vault-lock operation. Update the policy. Call the initiate-vault- lock operation again.
options.B: Copy the vault data to a new S3 bucket. Delete the vault Create a new vault with the data.
options.C: Update the policy to keep the vault lock in place.

explanations.A: Call the abort-vault-lock operation. Update the policy. Call the initiate-vault- lock operation again. 正确。 Vault Lock 的锁定过程分为两个阶段 : 初始化和完成。在 完成之前，可以通过调 ⽤ abort-vault-lock 操作来终 ⽌ 锁定过程并修改策略。这是最成 本效益的解决 ⽅ 案，因为不需要重新创建或复制数据。
explanations.B: Copy the vault data to a new S3 bucket. Delete the vault. Create a new vault with the data. 错误。这种 ⽅ 法成本 ⾼ 且不必要。复制 10 TB 的数据到新的 S3 bucket 会产 ⽣ 额外的存储和数据传输费 ⽤ ，同时删除和重新创建 Vault 也增加了复杂性。
explanations.C: Update the policy to keep the vault lock in place. 错误。 ⼀ 旦 Vault Lock 完成， 策略 ⽆ 法直接更新。此选项忽略了 Vault Lock 的不可变性。
explanations.D: Update the policy. Call the initiate-vault-lock operation again to apply the new policy. 错误。如果 Vault Lock 已经完成， ⽆ 法直接更新策略。此选项未提到如何 终 ⽌ 当前锁定过程。

question: A company operates a web application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The application listens on port 80 and port 443. The company uses an Application Load Balancer ALB) with AWS WAF to terminate SSL and to forward traffic to the application instances only on port 80. To meet the compliance requirements for restricted access, the engineer has received the publicand private CIDR block ranges for each subsidiary. What solution should the engineer use to implement the appropriate access restrictions for the application?

options.A: Create a NACL to allow access on TCP port 443 from the 1,500 subsidiary CIDR block ranges. Associate the NACL to both the NLB and EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an AWS security group to allow access on TCP port 443 from the 1,500 subsidiary CIDR block ranges. Associate the security group to the NLCreate a second security group for EC2 instances with access on TCP port 443 from the NLB security group.
options.C: Create an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service in the parent company account attached to the NLB. Create an AWS security group for the instances to allow access on TCP port 443 from the AWS PrivateLink endpoint. Use AWS PrivateLink interface endpoints in the 1,500 subsidiary AWS accounts to connect to the data processing application.
options.D: Create an AWS security group to allow access on TCP port 443 from the 1,500 subsidiary CIDR block ranges. Associate the security group with EC2 instances.

explanations.B: 和 EC2 实例。 错误原因： ⽹ 络 ACL （ NACL ）是 ⽆ 状态的， ⽆ 法区分流量的 ⽅ 向，且管 理 1,500 个 CIDR 块范围的规则会 ⾮ 常复杂且难以 维护。此外， NACL ⽆ 法直接关联到 NLB 。 B. 创建 ⼀ 个 AWS 安全组以允许来 ⾃ 1,500 个 ⼦ 公司 CIDR 块范围的 TCP 端 ⼝ 443 访问。将安全组关联到 NLB 。为 EC2 实 例创建第 ⼆ 个安全组，允许来 ⾃ NLB 安全组的 TCP 端 ⼝ 443 访问。 错误原因：虽然安全组是有状态的，但管理 1,500 个 CIDR 块范围的规则仍 然 ⾮ 常复杂且难以维护。此外，安全组 ⽆ 法直 接限制跨账户的访问。

question: A company has a requirement that no Amazon EC2 security group can allow SSH access from the CIDR block 0.0.0.0/0. The company wants to monitor compliance with this requirement at all times and wants to receive a near-real-time notification if any security group is noncompliant. A security engineer has configured AWS Config and will use the restricted-ssh managed rule to monitor the security groups. What should the security engineer do next to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Config to send its configuration snapshots to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function to run on a PutEvent to the S3 bucket. Configure the Lambda function to parse the snapshot for a compliance change to the restricted-ssh managed rule. Configure the Lambda function to send a notification to an Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon SNS) topic if a change is discovered.
options.B: Configure an Amazon EventBridge event rule that is invoked by a compliance change event from AWS Config for the restricted-ssh managed rule. Configure the event rule to target an Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon SNS) topic that will provide a notification.
options.C: Configure AWS Config to push all its compliance notifications to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure a CloudWatch Logs metric filter on the AWS Config log group to look for a compliance notification change on the restricted-ssh managed rule. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm on the metric filter to send a notification to an Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon SNS) topic if the alarm is in the ALARM state.
options.D: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch alarm on the CloudWatch metric for the restricted-ssh managed rule. Configure the CloudWatch alarm to send a notification to an Amazon Simple Notification Service Amazon SNS) topic if the alarm is in the ALARM state.

explanations.A: 配置 AWS Config 将其配置快照发送到 ⼀ 个 Amazon S3 存储桶，并使 ⽤ Lambda 函数解析快照 : 错误 :AWS Config 的快照是定期 ⽣ 成的， ⽽ 不是实时的，因此 ⽆ 法满 ⾜ “ 近实 时通知 ” 的要求。 错误 : 解析快照的 ⽅ 式效率较低，且需要额外的逻辑来处理合规性变化。
explanations.B: 配置 Amazon EventBridge 事件规则，由 AWS Config 的合规性更改事件 触发 : 正确 :AWS Config 可以直接与 Amazon EventBridge 集成， EventBridge 可以 实时捕获合规性变化事件。 正确 :EventBridge 规则可以直接将事件发送到 SNS 主题，实现近实时通知。
explanations.C: 配置 AWS Config 推送通知到 CloudWatch Logs ，并使 ⽤ 指标过滤器和 警报 : 错误 : 虽然可以通过 CloudWatch Logs 实现通知，但这种 ⽅ 法需要额外的配置 ( ⽇ 志过滤器和警报 ) ，复杂度较 ⾼ 。 错误 : 这种 ⽅ 法的通知延迟可能较 ⾼ ， ⽆ 法保证 “ 近实时通知 ” 。
explanations.D: 在 CloudWatch 指标上配置警报 : 错误 :AWS Config 的托管规则并不会直接 ⽣ 成 CloudWatch 指标，因此 ⽆ 法直 接在 CloudWatch 指标上配置警报。 错误 : 此选项与 AWS Config 的 ⼯ 作机制不匹配。
